scope: Actual face-on Schwarzschild null rays to prescribed equatorial surface brightness, ideal annular detector pixels, followed by synthetic-source inversion. Not rotating Kerr, VLBI, volumetric NeRF or an observational feasibility test.
engineering_preflight: 86 charged boundary/point evaluations before registration; three midpoint source rays inspected, not a holdout. No inverse outcomes inspected.

physics.radiative_law: specific surface brightness times g^3, no absorption; prescribed isotropic emitter spectrum
physics.solid_angle_measure: RO^2/fO times exact solid angle in projected impact coordinates, not flat b db dtheta approximation

physical_budget.count: each completed or failed b/order native or independent reference call, including boundary root residual evaluations

forward_validation.ray_reference: radial quadrature vs independent u(psi),uprime,t orbital ODE

detector.sigma_definition: unit-density direct constant-source response RMS divided by reference SNR; shared absolute density across all pixels/orders
detector.known_emission_annuli: root-located geometrically before source definition; separate disjoint order windows; ideal no PSF
detector.all_order_synthetic_measurements_generat: quad q64 radial x32 angular; independent checked on q8 and point cohort

sources.baseline: fixed 3-mode shearing contrast on r in [6,12], plus 1
sources.event2_variant_contains: both event1 and a differently moving event2
sources.novelty: events excluded by source-free advection, not physical photons beyond direct footprint automatically recovered

inverse.comoving_coordinate: phi-r^(-3/2)*t, retain explicit t so this is not exact-advection restriction
inverse.stage_base: time-independent in comoving coordinates, fit then freeze
inverse.residual: general time-dependent neural field fitted to residual observations
inverse.scope_of_ablation: same joint architecture isolates robust term; staging also changes parameter allocation and representation
inverse.baseline_selection: training-only GCV over fixed alpha grid, source dictionary fixed before its outcomes

template_diagnostic.columns: six background angular coefficients plus two fixed event shapes
template_diagnostic.event_amplitude_fitting: least squares covariance from physical noise, explicit rank/nullity
template_diagnostic.claim: known-template information diagnostic only, not free-form morphology reconstruction

Euler_inspiration.tested: structured coordinates and staged residual corrections
Euler_inspiration.certification: independent numerical agreement and refinement, not rigorous interval certificate

stop: Fail physical-reference gate before inverse phase; preserve all output and do not modify thresholds. No automatic interpolant sweep or new budget after this fixed pilot.
reporting: This is a registered development experiment, not externally sealed. Record every fit, failed attempt and archive hash. Production code, Paper_I and pilot002 data immutable.
